exposure: Targeted expression and external nine-gene pilot inspected; full-gene ranks, embedding fits and pathway enrichments not yet inspected. User requested additional UMAP, PCA, dot plots and enrichment visual aids.
historical_namespace: TN2020 run identifiers are preserved rather than rewritten

embedding.genes: top 1500 variance/mean-ranked log1p(CP10K) genes within 20 mean-expression bins; exclude MT-, RPL and RPS prefixes; minimum 10 detected cells
embedding.interpretation: New exploratory projection, no integration, clustering, trajectory or population prevalence claim. Donor/region overlays expose confounding. Original atlas coordinates are t-SNE and displayed under that name.

pseudobulk: All curated genes. Source 10x distal alveolar versus adventitial fibroblasts, fixed 20-cell-per-arm primary floor (P1/P3). External single-cell primary strata and four donors from external_pilot_v1; equal mean of stratum logCPM profiles within donor/type. No nuclei in enrichment.
gene_universe: Collapse exact duplicate feature_name columns by count sum. Require >=1 CPM in either subtype for at least 2 source donors and at least 3 external donors; use intersection across cohorts. Full gene library denominators before filtering.
ranking: Mean within-donor log2(CPM+1) difference, alveolar minus adventitial. Stable gene-symbol ordering for tied values; no cell-level significance tests.
pca_display: Separate cohort PCA on same common expressed genes, centered log2(CPM+1), top 2000 variance genes per cohort; no scaling, no joint batch correction; pairs linked by donor.

hallmark_gsea.interpretation: Gene-set permutation null only, not a donor-level biological significance test; report all sets and FDR within cohort.

complement_sensitivity: For preselected HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT, 1000 expression-matched random sets in 20 mean-expression bins; plus-one two-sided Monte Carlo p; descriptive competitive null, not population inference.

go_bp_ora.foreground: Separate positive/negative genes with absolute mean paired difference >=1 and same direction in both source donors or >=3/4 external donors
go_bp_ora.background: shared expression-eligible universe, not whole genome
go_bp_ora.test: hypergeometric overlap; BH across all eligible GO terms and both directions within each cohort
go_bp_ora.interpretation: Exploratory annotation of an effect-selected list, not statistically established DE genes. All terms retained; top plots are result-selected.

display_selection: GSEA: strongest 5 positive and 5 negative source NES, retaining external estimates. GO: top 5 per direction/cohort by adjusted p, showing all retained entries regardless of significance. Complement running curves selected before analysis.
